title: Protect Your Base
note: Every password here is a made-up example. Never use these for real accounts. Each step needs exactly 4 options and at least one correct one. 'correct' must agree with scripts/PasswordRules.gd (tests/lesson_flow.gd checks this). 'prank' is one of: flag_swap, paint, fold_wall, steal_hat.

intro: Hi, I'm Pip! Welcome to my treehouse in Digi-World.
Before we start, let's make this base yours!
lines.customize_done: Wow, it looks amazing! This is OUR base now.
lines.glitch_spotted: Uh oh... what's that on the ladder?!
lines.alert: That's a Glitch! Let's build a strong password to keep it out!
lines.finale: We did it! The Glitch can't get in anymore!

steps.title: Step 1: Make it long
steps.prompt: Pick the password with at least 8 letters.
steps.defense: Braced cabin door and gate on the upper deck
steps.cheer: Yes! A long password braces our cabin door and adds a gate to our deck!
steps.glitch_line: It jumped our short deck gate and reached an open window! We need taller protection and shutters.

options.explanation: 13 letters! Long passwords take way longer to guess.
That one was too short! Only 3 letters.
options.tip: Use at least 8 letters. Sticking a few words together works great.

options.explanation: "password" is the very first thing a Glitch tries!
options.tip: Skip famous passwords. Make up your own mix of words.

options.explanation: A name and a birthday year are easy to find out.
options.tip: Never use names, birthdays or things people know about you.

steps.title: Step 2: Mix big and small letters
steps.prompt: Add capital letters to your password. Which one mixes UPPER and lower case?
steps.defense: Taller deck gate, window shutters and a door crossbar
steps.cheer: Big and small letters! Our deck gate grows taller, and the cabin windows get shutters!
steps.glitch_line: Our gate and shutters stopped it! But now it is climbing the branches to reach the roof!

options.tip: Switch some letters to CAPITALS, like the start of each word.

options.explanation: Capitals AND small letters. Much trickier to guess!
ALL CAPS is just one kind of letter.
options.tip: Mix them! Some big letters, some small letters.

options.explanation: Oops, that made it too short again. Only 7 letters!
options.tip: Keep it long AND mix the letters.

steps.title: Step 3: Add numbers and symbols
steps.prompt: Finish your password with numbers AND symbols. Which one has both?
steps.defense: Reinforced cabin and wide overhanging branch shields
steps.cheer: Numbers and symbols! Wide shields block the branches, and our cabin is reinforced!

options.explanation: Nice symbol, but there's no number yet.
options.tip: Add numbers AND symbols, like 4 7 and #.

options.explanation: 2014 looks like a birthday year. Those are easy to guess!
options.tip: Pick random numbers, not birthdays or ages.

options.explanation: "Password123" is one of the most-guessed passwords ever!
options.tip: Adding 123 to a famous word doesn't fool anyone.

options.explanation: Long, mixed letters, numbers AND a symbol. Super strong!
